2108.description: For 18..25 seconds, you and your pet attack 25% faster and have 1..3 Health regeneration.

2109.name: Eternal Aura
2109.description: You have +100 max Health. When this enchantment ends, all party members in the area are resurrected with 40..50% Health and 20..30% Energy.

2110.name: Vampirism
2110.description: Create a level 4..14 spirit that dies after 75..150 seconds. Attacks by this spirit steal up to 10..20 Health, and you are healed for 10..20 Health.

2112.name: "There's Nothing to Fear!"
2112.description: For 4 seconds and 1 second for every 2 ranks in Leadership, all party members within earshot take 20..35% less damage. Affected party members are healed for 35..60 Health when this shout ends.

2116.name: Sneak Attack
2116.description: If this attack hits, target foe is Blinded for 5..8 seconds. This attack counts as a lead attack.

2131.name: Armor of Unfeeling (PvP)
2131.description: For 10..35 seconds, you have 10 base damage reduction while casting Binding Rituals.

2132.name: Aura of Thorns (PvP)
2132.description: All nearby foes begin Bleeding for 5..15 seconds. For 30 seconds, this enchantment does nothing. When this enchantment ends, all nearby foes are Crippled for 3..8 seconds.

2134.name: Ballad of Restoration (PvP)
2134.description: For 10 seconds, the next time each party member within earshot takes damage, that party member gains 15..75 Health.

2135.name: Trampling Ox
2135.description: Must follow an off-hand attack. If it hits, you deal +5..20 damage. If you a  hit a Crippled foe, that foe is knocked down.

2136.name: Smoke Powder Defense
2136.description: For 8 seconds, the next time you are struck, you take half damage and all adjacent foes are Blinded for 2..6 seconds.

2137.name: Confusing Images
2137.description: For 2..10 seconds, target foe takes twice as long to activate non-attack skills.

2138.name: Hexer's Vigor
2138.description: For 10 seconds, you have +1..8 Health regeneration. Hexer's Vigor ends if you cast a non-hex skill.

2139.name: Masochism
2139.description: For 10..40 seconds, you have +2 to your Death Magic and Soul Reaping attributes and sacrifice 5..3% of your maximum Health when you cast a spell.

2140.name: Piercing Trap
2140.description: When Piercing Trap is triggered, all nearby foes are struck for 5..50 piercing damage. Any foes with Cracked Armor are struck for an additional 15..60 damage. Piercing Trap ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.

2141.name: Companionship
2141.description: If you have less Health than your pet, you are healed for 30..120 Health. If your pet has less Health than you, it is healed for 30..120 Health.

2142.name: Feral Aggression
2142.description: For 5..20 seconds, your pet attacks 33% faster and deals +3..10 additional damage.

2143.name: Disrupting Shot
2143.description: If this attack hits, target foe's action is interrupted. If that action was a Skill, you strike for +10..40 damage.

2144.name: Volley
2144.description: All your Preparations are removed. Shoot arrows at target foe and up to 3 foes adjacent to your target. These arrows strike for +1..10 damage if they hit.

2145.name: Expert Focus
2145.description: For 24 seconds, your bow attack skills cost 1..2 less Energy and deal 1..10 extra damage.

2146.name: Pious Fury
2146.description: Remove one Dervish enchantment. For 1..7 second[s], you attack 25% faster. If an enchantment was removed, this stance lasts twice as long.

2147.name: Crippling Victory
2147.description: If this attack hits a foe, that foe is Crippled for 3..8 seconds. If you have more Health than target foe, all adjacent foes take 10..30 earth damage.

2148.name: Sundering Weapon
2148.description: For 4..10 seconds, target ally's next 3 attacks have 10% armor penetration and cause Cracked Armor for 5..20 seconds.

2149.name: Weapon of Renewal
2149.description: For 5..20 seconds, the next time target ally hits with an attack skill, that ally gains 1..7 Energy.

2150.name: Maiming Spear
2150.description: If your attack hits a Bleeding foe, that foe is Crippled for 5..20 seconds.

2154.name: Crippling Anguish (PvP)
2154.description: For 5..20 seconds, target moves 50% slower and suffers -2..6 Health degeneration.

2160.name: Death Pact Signet (PvP)
2160.description: Resurrect target party member with your current Health and 15..100% Energy. The next time that ally dies within 120 seconds, so do you.

2161.name: Defensive Anthem (PvP)
2161.description: For 4..10 seconds, each party member within earshot has a 50% chance to block incoming attacks. This chant ends if that party member hits with an attack skill.

2163.name: Destructive Was Glaive (PvP)
2163.description: Hold Glaive's ashes for up to 30..60 seconds. While you hold her ashes, all Ritualist skills have 10% armor penetration. When you drop her ashes, all foes in the area are struck for 15..85 lightning damage.

2164.name: Disenchantment (PvP)
2164.description: Create a level 1..8 spirit. This spirit deals 5..20 damage and anyone struck by its attack loses one enchantment. This spirit dies after 15..40 seconds.

2167.name: Dust Cloak (PvP)
2167.description: All adjacent foes are struck for 10..40 earth damage. For 30 seconds, your attacks deal earth damage. When this enchantment ends, all adjacent foes are Blinded for 1..4 second[s].

2168.name: Earthbind (PvP)
2168.description: Create a level 1..10 spirit. All non-spirit foes knocked down within its range are knocked down for at least 3 seconds. Whenever this happens, this spirit loses 50..25 Health. This spirit dies after 15..45 seconds.

2172.name: Empowerment (PvP)
2172.description: Create a level 1..10 spirit. All allies within its range holding an item gain 15..45 maximum Health and 10 maximum Energy. This spirit dies after 15..60 seconds.

2173.name: Enchanter's Conundrum (PvP)
2173.description: For 10 seconds, target foe casts enchantments 100..200% slower. If target foe is not under the effects of an enchantment when this hex is applied, that foe takes 10..100 damage and foes in the area take 75% of that damage.

2176.name: Enraged Lunge (PvP)
2176.description: Your animal companion attempts an Enraged Lunge that deals +3..23 damage (maximum bonus 60) for each recharging Beast Mastery skill.

2186.name: Signet of Deadly Corruption
2186.description: Target foe takes 5..35 damage for each condition on that foe (maximum 130 damage).

2187.name: Way of the Master
2187.description: For 60 seconds, while holding a non-dagger weapon, you have an additional 3..33% chance to land a critical hit.

2188.name: Defile Defenses
2188.description: For 5..20 seconds, the next time target foe blocks, that foe takes 30..120 damage.

2189.name: Angorodon's Gaze
2189.description: Steal 10..50 Health from target foe. If you are suffering from a condition, you gain 3..12 Energy.

2190.name: Magnetic Surge
2190.description: Target foe takes 15..75 damage. If you are Overcast, Magnetic Surge enchants all allies in earshot for 1..5 second[s] to block the next attack against them.

2191.name: Slippery Ground
2191.description: If target or adjacent foes are Blind or moving, these foes are knocked down. There is a 50% chance of failure with Water Magic less than 5.

2192.name: Glowing Ice
2192.description: Target foe is struck for 5..50 cold damage. If that foe is under the effects of a Water Magic hex, you gain 5 Energy plus 1 Energy for every 2 ranks of Energy Storage.

2193.name: Energy Blast
2193.description: Target foe takes 1..2 damage for each point of Energy you have (maximum 130 damage).

2194.name: Distracting Strike
2194.description: If Distracting Strike hits, it deals no damage and interrupts target foe's action. If target foe has Cracked Armor, that skill is disabled for 30 seconds.

2195.name: Symbolic Strike
2195.description: If this attack hits, you deal +12 damage for each signet you have equipped (maximum 70 damage).

2196.name: Soldier's Speed
2196.description: For 3..18 seconds, you move 15% faster. You move an additional 15% faster while under the effects of a chant or shout.

2197.name: Body Blow
2197.description: If this attack hits, target foe takes +10..40 damage. If target foe has Cracked Armor, that foe suffers from a Deep Wound for 0..15 second[s].

2198.name: Body Shot
2198.description: If this attack hits, you deal +5..20 damage. If it hits a foe with Cracked Armor, you gain 5..10 Energy.

2199.name: Poison Tip Signet
2199.description: For 60 seconds, your next attack also inflicts Poison for 8..15 seconds.

2200.name: Signet of Mystic Speed
2200.description: For 30 seconds, your next 1..3 self-targeting enchantment[s] cast instantly. Flash enchantments do not consume uses of this skill.

2201.name: Shield of Force
2201.description: For 1..16 second[s], blocks the next 1 attack against you. If an attack is blocked, all adjacent attacking foes are knocked down and suffer from Weakness for 5..20 seconds.

2202.name: Mending Grip
2202.description: Target ally is healed for 30..90 Health. If that ally is under the effects of a weapon spell, that ally loses one condition.

2203.name: Spiritleech Aura
2203.description: For 5..20 seconds, all of your spirits within earshot deal 5..20 less damage and steal 5..20 Health when they attack.

2204.name: Rejuvenation
2204.description: Create a level 1..20 spirit. This spirit heals all party members within earshot for 3..10 Health each second. This spirit loses 3..10 Health for each party member healed in this way. This spirit dies after 30..90 seconds.

2205.name: Agony
2205.description: Create a level 1..12 spirit. This spirit causes 3..10 Health loss each second to foes within earshot. This spirit loses 3..10 Health for each foe hurt in this way. This spirit dies after 30..90 seconds.

2206.name: Ghostly Weapon
2206.description: For 5..20 seconds, target other ally's next attack cannot be blocked.

2207.name: Inspirational Speech
2207.description: You lose all adrenaline and target other ally gains 1..8 strikes of adrenaline.

2208.name: Burning Shield
2208.description: For 3..9 seconds, while wielding a shield, the next attack skill used against you is blocked. If it was a melee attack, your attacker is set on fire for 1..6 seconds.

2209.name: Holy Spear
2209.description: If this attack hits, you deal +5..20 damage. If it hits a summoned creature, all nearby foes take 15..90 holy damage, and are set on fire for 3 seconds.

2210.name: Spear Swipe
2210.description: If this attack hits, you deal +5..20 damage and target foe is Dazed for 4..10 seconds. This attack has melee range.

2211.name: Alkar's Alchemical Acid
2211.description: Throw Alkar's Alchemical Acid at target foe. Target and adjacent foes are struck for 40..50 damage. Destroyers take an additional 45..70 damage and they have Cracked Armor for 14..20 seconds.

2212.name: Light of Deldrimor
2212.description: All foes in the area are struck for 55..80 holy damage. The location of hidden objects are briefly indicated on your Compass. Any hidden objects in the area are revealed.

2213.name: Ear Bite
2213.description: Target touched foe takes 50..70 piercing damage and begins Bleeding for 15..25 seconds.

2214.name: Low Blow
2214.description: Strike target foe for 45..70 damage. If target foe is knocked down, that foe takes an additional 30..50 damage and suffers from Cracked Armor for 14..20 seconds.

2215.name: Brawling Headbutt
2215.description: You headbutt target touched foe dealing 45..70 damage and knocking down that foe if it hits.

2216.name: Don't Trip!
2216.description: For 3..5 seconds, party members within earshot cannot be knocked down.

2217.name: By Ural's Hammer!
2217.description: For 30 seconds, all dead party members in earshot are resurrected with full Health and Energy. Resurrected party members deal 25..33% more damage. When this effect ends, affected party members die. This skill does not incur a death penalty.

2218.name: Drunken Master
2218.description: For 72..90 seconds, your movement and attack speeds are increased by 10..15%. If you are drunk while activating this skill, your movement and attack speeds are increased by 25..33% instead.

2219.name: Great Dwarf Weapon
2219.description: For 20 seconds, target other ally's weapon strikes for +15..20 damage and has a 28..40% chance to cause knock down.

2220.name: Great Dwarf Armor
2220.description: For 22..40 seconds, target ally has +24 armor, +60 maximum Health, and an additional +24 armor against Destroyers.

2221.name: Breath of the Great Dwarf
2221.description: All party members are relieved of Burning and are healed for 50..60 Health.

2222.name: Snow Storm
2222.description: Create a Snow Storm at target foe's location. For 5 seconds, foes adjacent to that location are struck for 30..40 cold damage each second.

2223.name: Black Powder Mine
2223.description: When Black Powder Mine is triggered, all nearby foes are struck for 20..30 damage, become Blinded, and begin Bleeding for 7..10 seconds. Black Powder Mine ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.

2224.name: Summon Mursaat
2224.description: Summon a level 14..20 Mursaat that lives for 40..60 seconds and has Enervating Charge. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active at a time.

2225.name: Summon Ruby Djinn
2225.description: Summon a level 14..20 Ruby Djinn that lives for 40..60 seconds and has Immolate. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active at a time.

2226.name: Summon Ice Imp
2226.description: Summon a level 14..20 Ice Imp that lives for 40..60 seconds and has Ice Spikes. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active a time.

2227.name: Summon Naga Shaman
2227.description: Summon a level 14..20 Naga Shaman that lives for 40..60 seconds and has Stoning. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active a time.

2228.name: Deft Strike
2228.description: If this attack hits, target foe takes 18..30 damage. If that foe has Cracked Armor, it begins Bleeding for 18..30 seconds.

2229.name: Signet of Infection
2229.description: If target foe is Bleeding, that foe is Diseased for 13..20 seconds.

2230.name: Tryptophan Signet
2230.description: For 14..20 seconds, target foe and all adjacent foes move and attack 23..40% slower.

2231.name: Ebon Battle Standard of Courage
2231.description: You plant an Ebon Battle Standard of Courage at your current location. For 14..20 seconds, non-spirit allies in this area gain +24 armor and an additional +24 armor against Charr.

2232.name: Ebon Battle Standard of Wisdom
2232.description: You plant an Ebon Battle Standard of Wisdom at your current location. For 14..20 seconds, non-spirit allies in this area have a 44..60% chance to halve skill recharge of spells they cast.

2233.name: Ebon Battle Standard of Honor
2233.description: You plant an Ebon Battle Standard of Honor at your current location. For 14..20 seconds, non-spirit allies in this area strike for +8..15 damage and an additional +7..10 vs. Charr.

acquisition.quests: The Smell of Titan in the Morning|https://wiki.guildwars.com/wiki/The_Smell_of_Titan_in_the_Morning

2234.name: Ebon Vanguard Sniper Support
2234.description: Target foe is struck for 54..90 piercing damage and begins Bleeding for 5..25 seconds. This attack has a 10% chance of doing an additional +540..900 piercing damage. If this attack hits a Charr it has a 25% chance of doing an additional +540..900 piercing damage.

2235.name: Ebon Vanguard Assassin Support
2235.description: Summon a level 14..20 Ebon Vanguard Assassin that has Iron Palm, Fox Fangs, and Nine Tail Strike. This summoned Assassin Shadow Steps to target foe. If that foe is a Charr, the Assassin lives for 24..30 seconds. If target foe is not a Charr, the Assassin lives for 12..15 seconds.

2236.name: Well of Ruin
2236.description: Exploit nearest corpse to create a Well of Ruin at its location. For 5..30 seconds, whenever a foe in the well takes physical damage, that foe has Cracked Armor for 5..20 seconds.

2237.name: Atrophy
2237.description: For 3..7 seconds, target foe's primary attribute is reduced to 0.

2238.name: Spear of Redemption
2238.description: If this attack hits, you deal +5..20 damage. If it fails to hit, you lose one condition.

2353.name: "Finish Him!"
2353.description: If target foe has less than 50% Health, that foe takes 44..80 damage and suffers from Cracked Armor and a Deep Wound for 12..20 seconds.

2354.name: "Dodge This!"
2354.description: For 16..20 seconds, your next attack cannot be blocked and does +14..20 damage.

2355.name: I Am the Strongest!
2355.description: Your next 5..8 attacks do an additional +14..20 damage.

2356.name: "I Am Unstoppable!"
2356.description: For 16..20 seconds, you have +24 armor and cannot be knocked down or Crippled.

2357.name: A Touch of Guile
2357.description: Target touched foe takes 44..80 damage. If target foe was knocked down, that foe cannot attack for 5..8 seconds.

2358.name: "You Move Like a Dwarf!"
2358.description: Target foe is knocked down and takes 44..80 damage. That foe is also Crippled for 8..15 seconds.

2359.name: You Are All Weaklings!
2359.description: Target foe and foes adjacent to target are Weakened for 8..12 seconds.

2360.name: Feel No Pain
2360.description: For 30 seconds you have +2..3 Health regeneration. If you are drunk when activating this skill, you also have +200..300 maximum Health.

2361.name: Club of a Thousand Bears
2361.description: If this attack hits, it deals +6..9 damage for each adjacent foe (maximum 60 damage). If target foe is non-human it is knocked down.

2379.name: Volfen Blessing
2379.description: You lose all effects and take on the aspect of the wolf. For 60 seconds, you have 80 armor, 660..700 Health, and 2..4 Health regeneration. All your attributes are set to 0 and wolf attacks replace your skills.

2384.name: Raven Blessing
2384.description: You lose all effects and take on the aspect of the raven. For 60 seconds, you have 80 armor, 660..700 Health, and a 20..30% chance to block, All your attributes are set to 0 and raven attacks replace your skills.

2411.name: Mindbender

2412.name: Smooth Criminal
2412.description: For 10..20 seconds, one random spell is disabled for target foe and Smooth Criminal is replaced by that spell. You gain 5..10 Energy.

2413.name: Technobabble
2413.description: Target foe and all adjacent foes are struck for 30..40 damage. If target foe is not a boss, that foe and all adjacent foes are Dazed for 3..5 seconds.

2414.name: Radiation Field
2414.description: For 5 seconds, foes in the area have -4..6 Health degeneration. When the portal ends, foes in the area are Diseased for 12..20 seconds.

2415.description: For 9..12 seconds your attacks cannot miss target foe. Killing a foe hexed with Asuran Scan removes 5% Death Penalty.

2416.name: Air of Superiority
2416.description: For 20..30 seconds you gain a random Asura benefit every time you earn experience from killing an enemy.

2417.name: Mental Block
2417.description: For 5..11 seconds you have a 50% chance to block attacks. This Enchantment is reapplied every time an enemy strikes you.

2418.name: Pain Inverter
2418.description: For 6..10 seconds, every time target foe deals damage that foe takes 100..140% of the damage it causes (maximum 80 damage).

2420.name: Ebon Escape
2420.description: Shadow Step to target other ally. You and that other ally are healed for 70..110 health.

2421.name: Weakness Trap
2421.description: When Weakness Trap is triggered, all nearby foes are Weakened for 10..20 seconds and take 24..50 lightning damage. All Charr are knocked down. Weakness Trap ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.

2422.description: Create a level 4..10 Spirit. All foes within its range have 15% chance to miss with ranged attacks. This spirit dies after 54..90 seconds.

2423.name: Dwarven Stability
2423.description: For 24..30 seconds, your stances last 55..100% longer. If you activated this skill while drunk, you cannot be knocked down.

2657.name: Call of Haste (PvP)
2657.description: For 30 seconds, your animal companion has a 25% faster attack speed and moves 25% faster.

2714.name: Dark Soul Explosion
2714.description: Skill. When an Afflicted Necromancer dies, all foes in the area are struck for 25..65 dark damage, lose 1..4 enchantments, and suffer from Disease and Weakness for 10 seconds.

2715.name: Chaotic Soul Explosion
2715.description: Skill. When an Afflicted Mesmer dies, all foes in the area lose 2 enchantments. Each foe takes 25..65 damage and loses 1..4 Energy for each enchantment lost.

2716.name: Fiery Soul Explosion
2716.description: Skill. When an Afflicted Elementalist dies, all foes in the area take 50..90 damage and begin burning for 4..7 seconds.

2717.name: Rejuvenating Soul Explosion
2717.description: Skill. When an Afflicted Monk dies, all foes in the area are struck for 25..65 damage. Additionally, all Afflicted in the area are healed for 50..130 and lose 1 hex and 1 condition.

2718.name: Plague Spring
2718.description: Skill. When an Afflicted Ranger dies, it creates a Plague Spring at its location that lasts for 10 seconds. Every 2 seconds, nearby Afflicted are healed for 35..71, and foes in the area take 35..71 damage.

2719.name: Unbalancing Soul Explosion
2719.description: Skill. When an Afflicted Warrior dies, all nearby foes are struck for 50..90 blunt damage. Additionally, they are knocked down and lose their current stance.

2720.name: Shadowy Soul Explosion
2720.description: Skill. When an Afflicted Assassin dies, all enemies in the area are struck for 25..65 damage, and all Afflicted in the area move and attack 25% faster for 10..14 seconds.

2721.name: Ethereal Soul Explosion
2721.description: Skill. When an Afflicted Ritualist dies, all foes within spirit range take 50..70 damage. Summoned creatures take double damage and begin burning for 4..7 seconds.

2733.name: Smiter's Boon (PvP)
2733.description: For 4 seconds, your Smiting Prayers have double the Divine Favor bonus.

2734.name: Mind Wrack (PvP)
2734.description: For 5..40 seconds, whenever this foe is the target of one of your non-hex Mesmer skills, that foe loses 1 Energy. If the target foe's Energy drops to 0, Mind Wrack ends and that foe takes 15..100 damage.

30016.description: Stance. Reduces damage from non-critical hits.

30017.name: Blessing of the Kirin
30017.description: Enchantment Spell. For 30 seconds, the next time a nearby ally of this Kirin uses a skill, that ally is cured of Miasma or one condition.

30018.name: Jade Fury
30018.description: Spell.  All foes in the area take 50 damage, are knocked down, and then take an additional 150 damage.

30019.name: Afflicted Soul Explosion
30019.description: When Afflicted creature dies, all nearby foes take damage.

30020.name: Song of the Mists
30020.description: Shout. For 10 seconds, each nearby ally gains +6 Energy regeneration. If an ally successfully uses a skill, Song of The Mists ends and steals 20 Health from the nearest foe.

30022.name: Kournan Siege
30022.description: Skill. A signal flare is fired into the air to summon siege fire from any nearby garrisons. Every 3 seconds for 12 seconds, targets hit by the siege fire take 40 damage and are interrupted. This skill is easily interrupted.

30023.name: Abaddon's Chosen
30023.description: Enchantment Spell. Target cannot lose Health for 10 seconds.

30024.name: Abaddon's Favor
30024.description: Skill.  If target ally is enchanted with Abaddon's Chosen, all foes in the area lose 70 Health and target ally gains 70 Health.

30025.name: Call to the Torment
30025.description: Skill. Creature kneels for 5 seconds and takes double damage. After 5 seconds, a duplicate of the creature is summoned to this location.

30026.name: Corsair's Net
30026.description: Hex Spell. Throw a net at target foe. On impact, all foes in the area move slower for 10 seconds. The net projectile flies at a quarter of the normal speed.

30030.name: Skin of Stone
30030.description: Caster can only be harmed by wurm siege.

30031.name: Enraged
30031.description: Skill. Attacks and skills do +50% damage if this creature's Health is below 70%, and an additional +50% damage if its Health is below 30%.

30032.name: Touch of Aaaaarrrrrrggghhh
30032.description: Skill. Target foe's attributes are set to 0 for 20 seconds, and target foe and another random foe swap positions.

30033.name: Elemental Shift
30033.description: Form. Creature becomes attuned to a different element.

30034.name: Monkey See, Monkey Do
30034.description: Skill. For 20 seconds, this skill is replaced by a skill currently in use by a random friend or foe within earshot. The new skill activates with an attribute level equal to the caster's rank in that attribute.

30035.name: Chomp
30035.description: Skill. Caster gains 500 Health after destroying target touched smaller creature.

30036.name: Twisting Jaws
30036.description: Skill. Creature steals 120 Health from target touched foe. That foe suffers from a Deep Wound and begins Bleeding for 10 seconds.

30037.name: Tengu's Mimicry
30037.description: Shout. This Tengu repeats any shout it hears.

30038.name: Gloat
30038.description: Skill. After killing an enemy, all Charr within earshot gain 10 Energy and 5 adrenaline.

30039.name: Flame Call
30039.description: Skill. A signal horn sounds a warning that intruders have entered the temple.

30041.name: Ground Cover
30041.description: Creature has 50% chance to block attack [sic] while moving.

30042.name: Mandragor's Charge
30042.description: Spell. Shadow Step to target foe. That foe is knocked down and takes 60 damage.

30043.name: False Death
30043.description: Insects have a 25% chance of resurrecting when killed. Insects are resurrected with 25% Health and Energy.

30044.name: Parasitic Bite
30044.description: Melee Attack. If this attack is successful, target foe has -1 Health degeneration and you have +1 Health regeneration for 5 seconds.

30046.name: Inner Fire
30046.description: Skill. For 10 seconds, you gain 30 Health every second.

30047.name: Berserk
30047.description: Skill. For 10 seconds, all skills do double damage and randomly give the target one of the following conditions for 10 seconds: Cripple, Bleeding, Deep Wound, Weakness, or Dazed.

30048.name: Snaring Web
30048.description: Hex Spell. Creature launches a Snaring Web. For 15 seconds, foes near target that are hit by Snaring Web are Crippled and activate skills 100% slower.

30049.name: Soulrending Shriek
30049.description: Skill. Target foe takes 40 damage. If target is enchanted, that foe loses one enchantment and is Dazed for 8 seconds.

30050.name: Metamorphosis
30050.description: Skill. Creature changes into an adult krait.

30051.name: Trample
30051.description: Skill. Target touched foe and all adjacent foes are knocked down and struck for 80 damage.

30052.name: Ehzah from Above
30052.description: Skill. Target touched foe is knocked down for 3 seconds and suffers from a Deep Wound for 10 seconds.

30053.name: Blood Rage
30053.description: Skill. For 15 seconds, you attack 25% faster and deal 25% more damage with attacks, but cannot use non-attack skills.

30056.name: Bonds of Torment
30056.description: Hex Spell. Any Time the caster takes damage, all foes hexed with Bonds of Torment take equal cold damage.

30057.name: Devourer Siege
30057.description: Skill. Launch two projectiles at target foe's location. Foes near that location are struck for 150 fire damage and knocked down. This skill cannot target a foe near you.

30058.name: Sweeping Strikes
30058.description: This creatures [sic] attacks hit two additional adjacent foes.

30061.name: Abaddon's Conspiracy
30061.description: Enchantment Spell. Target other ally gains 100 Health every second for 3 seconds. When this enchantment ends normally, you are healed for 300 Health. This skill cannot be disabled.

30062.name: Wave of Torment
30062.description: Spell. All enemies in the area are hit for 150 damage.

30063.name: Quake Of Ahdashim
30063.description: Attack. Players in the area are knocked down for 4 seconds and take 100 damage. If a player is carrying a bundle item, that bundle item is destroyed. This skill cannot be disabled.

30064.name: Soul Torture
30064.description: Skill. Caster consumes a soul, ripping it from this world and sending it to Dhuum.

30065.name: Tremor
30065.description: Shout. All foes within earshot are knocked down for 4 seconds.

30066.name: Shield of Fire
30066.description: Skill. For 20 seconds, all damage dealt to this creature is inflicted upon the attacker as well. This skill cannot recharge slower than normal.

30067.name: Infernal Rage
30067.description: Stance. For 45 seconds, this creature has +1,000 maximum Health and attacks 33% faster, and its melee attacks hit target and nearby foes.

30068.name: Whirling Fires
30068.description: Skill. All foes in the area take 120 fire damage.

30069.name: Inscribed Ettin Aura
30069.description: This aura is a passive buff that loops consistently on an Inscribed Ettin, signifying that this creature is inscribed.

30070.name: Temporal Sheen
30070.description: Monster is immune to damage from all sources except Flux Energy.

30071.name: Spawn Pods
30071.description: Skill. Summons 2 Destroyer Spawns in the area.

30072.name: Rolling Shift
30072.description: Attack. Creature shifts form to attack.

30073.name: Thommis's Blessing
30073.description: Skill. conditions [sic] and hexes on you expire 50% faster.

30074.name: Strength of Purity
30074.description: Stance. Your next 1...3...4 attacks strike for +1...10...12 damage and deal holy damage. If these attacks are blocked or miss, your target loses one 1 enchantment and you lose 1 hex.

30075.name: Spring of Purity
30075.description: Trap. Create a Spring of Purity at your location that lasts for 10 seconds. Every two seconds, Spring of Purity removes 1 hex from adjacent allies, and removes 1 enchantment from adjacent foes.

30076.name: Purifying Prayer
30076.description: Spell. Removes 2...4...4 hexes and 2...4...4 conditions from target ally. For each hex removed, 1 foe near target ally loses an enchantment.

30077.name: Redemption of Purity
30077.description: Spell. Destroy target minion. That minion is replaced with a level 12 Spirit of Pain. This Spirit deals 30 damage. This Spirit dies after 150 seconds.

30078.name: Purify Energy
30078.description: Spell. Remove an enchantment from all nearby foes. If enchantments are removed, you steal 1 Energy from each foe who loses an enchantment.

30079.name: Purifying Flame
30079.description: Spell. Create a Purifying Flame at your location. For 5 seconds, this flame deals 10...10...10 damage to foes in the area. When Purifying Flame ends, foes in the area lose 1 enchantment, and allies in the area lose 1 hex.

30080.name: Way of the Pure
30080.description: Stance. For 5...11...13  seconds, you attack and move 25% faster, and your critical hits remove an enchantment from target foe.

30081.name: Purify Soul
30081.description: Spell. All friendly spirits within earshot gain +1 health regeneration for 3 seconds. All enemy spirits within earshot begin burning for 3 seconds.

30082.name: Anthem of Purity
30082.description: Chant. Removes 1 hex and 1 condition from all allies within earshot. For each hex removed, enemies within earshot lose 1 enchantment.

30083.name: Aura of Purity
30083.description: Flash Enchantment Spell. All adjacent foes lose 1 enchantment. For 10 seconds, your attacks deal +1...10...12 holy damage. When Aura of Purity ends, all adjacent foes lose one enchantment.

30084.name: Ooze Combination
30084.description: Skill. Combine with target touched ooze.

30085.name: Ooze Division
30085.description: Skill. Ooze loses half of its current Health and creates a duplicate.

30086.name: Consuming Flames
30086.description: Melee Attack. Remove one enchantment from target touched foe. Do 400 fire damage split evenly among target foe and adjacent foes, gain life equal to the damage you did to one target.

30087.name: Firebomb
30087.description: Skill. Launch a slow-moving firebomb at this foe. This skill cannot recharge slower than normal.

30088.name: Fleshreaver's Escape
30088.description: Spell. All adjacent foes suffer from Poison, Disease, and Weakness for 10 seconds, and you teleport to a random nearby location.

30089.name: The Master's Mark
30089.description: Hex Spell. For 24 seconds, target foe suffers -1 Health degeneration. If that foe is hit with the Sniper's Spear, this hex ends.

30090.name: The Sniper's Spear
30090.description: Ranged Attack. If target foe is under the effect of the Master's Mark, that foe takes +120 damage, is knocked down, and suffers from a Deep Wound for 20 seconds. This attack cannot be blocked.

30091.name: Murakai's Calamity
30091.description: Spell. Murakai's Calamity washes over all foes, dealing 90 damage and inflicting Poison, Disease, Bleeding, Crippled, and Weakness for 10 seconds. 1 Servant of Murakai comes to her aid.

30092.name: Murakai's Call
30092.description: Spell. Murakai's Call summons 3 undead servants.

30093.name: Murakai's Censure
30093.description: Spell. Murakai's Censure washes over all foes, dealing 80 damage and causing Poison and Disease for 10 seconds.

30094.name: Murakai's Consumption
30094.description: Spell. Murakai steals 60 Health from all foes in the target's location. Murakai's Power meter rises by 20 for each foe struck.

30095.name: Murakai's Storm of Souls
30095.description: Spell. Murakai's Storm of Souls washes over all foes, dealing 100 damage, knocking them down, and inflicting Poison, Disease, Bleeding, Burning, Crippled, Weakness, Blindness, Dazed, Deep Wound and Cracked Armor (10 seconds). 1 Servants of Murakai [sic] come to her aid.

30096.name: Unstable Aura
30096.description: Skill. For 30 seconds, if the golem is struck by elemental damage, all of its attacks are converted to that damage type.

30097.name: Unstable Pulse
30097.description: Skill. For 10 seconds, if the golem is struck by elemental damage, all of its attacks are converted to that damage type and Unstable Pulse ends. When Unstable Pulse ends, the golem hits all adjacent foes for 175 damage.

30098.name: Fungal Explosion
30098.description: Skill. This plant spore explodes, causing Poison and Diseased [sic] to nearby foes; also spreads seeds for new fungus.

30099.name: Dormant Husk
30099.description: Skill. This plant has 40 damage reduction and +20 Health regeneration while dormant but cannot attack or use other skills.

30102.name: Ursan Rage
30102.description: Deals 30..90 physical damage to adjacent foes and knocks them down.

30103.name: Ursan Roar
30103.description: Inflicts Weakness (5..15s) on nearby foes. Nearby allies deal +15..35 bonus damage on their next attack.

30104.name: Ursan Force
30104.description: You move 25..40% faster for 8 seconds and break wooden barricades.

30105.name: Volfen Claw
30105.description: Deals 40...90 physical damage and inflicts Deep Wound (5...15s).

30106.name: Volfen Agility
30106.description: For 10 seconds, Volfen skills recharge 66% faster.

30107.name: Volfen Pounce
30107.description: For 8 seconds, you move 33% faster and deal 20..50 damage to adjacent foes whenever you hit.

30108.name: Volfen Bloodlust
30108.description: Adjacent allies attack 33% faster for 10..20 seconds.

30109.name: Raven Talons
30109.description: Deals 40..90 physical damage and inflicts Bleeding (5..15s).

30110.name: Raven Swoop
30110.description: Deals 30..80 physical damage and inflicts Blindness (3..8s) on target foe.

30111.name: Raven Shriek
30111.description: Deals 20..60 damage to nearby foes and interrupts target foe.

30112.name: Raven Flight
30112.description: For 8..15 seconds, you move 33% faster and have a 50% chance to block incoming attacks.

30113.name: Totem of Man
30113.description: Returns you to human form and restores your original skillbar.

30114.name: "Let's Get 'Em!"
30114.description: Shout. For 5 seconds, all allies within earshot move 10% faster. You gain 1 strike of adrenaline for each ally affected.

30115.name: Flurry of Ice
30115.description: Spell. Throw a snowball at up to 4 foes adjacent to your target. These snowballs deal 50 damage if they hit.

30116.name: Mega Snowball
30116.description: Spell. You throw a very slow-moving snowball at target foe. That foe is knocked down and takes 75 damage if it hits.

30117.name: Snowball
30117.description: Spell. You throw a slow-moving snowball at target foe and gain 1 strike of adrenaline. That foe takes 50 damage if it hits.

30118.name: Ice Breaker
30118.description: Enchantment Spell. For 10 seconds, target ally has +5 Health regeneration and anyone striking target ally with an attack is knocked down.

30119.name: Hidden Rock
30119.description: Glyph. Your next snowball knocks down target foe and causes Daze for 10 seconds.

30120.name: "Mmmm. Snowcone!"
30120.description: Shout. You are healed for 300 Health, and all of your Skills are disabled for 10 seconds.

30121.name: Snow Down the Shirt
30121.description: Hex Spell. For 20 seconds, whenever touched foe takes any damage while suffering from this hex, that foe is interrupted.

30122.name: Holiday Blues
30122.description: Spell. Sacrifice 50% maximum Health. All nearby foes take 50 damage, and you bring the Holiday Blues to this location. For 30 seconds, foes within the area suffer -15 Health degeneration.

30123.name: Blinding Snow
30123.description: Spell. You interrupt target foe's action. That foe is Blinded for 10 seconds.

30124.name: Ice Fort
30124.description: Enchantment Spell. For 10 seconds, you cannot be knocked down, you are immune to conditions, and all incoming damage is reduced to 0. Ice Fort ends if you move.

30125.name: Jack Frost
30125.description: Binding Ritual. Create a level 5 Jack Frost. This creature deals 50 damage with snowballs. This creature dies after 60 seconds.

30126.name: Steady Aim
30126.description: Shout. For 10 seconds, the next time each ally within earshot throws a snowball, that snowball moves 100% faster.

30127.name: Avalanche
30127.description: Avalanches are large creatures made of snow and ice, encountered on the Far Shiverpeaks mountains.

30128.name: Unstable Ooze Explosion
30128.description: Skill. Nearby foes take 133 damage when the unstable ooze explodes.

30129.name: Gelatinous Absorption
30129.description: Skill. For 15 seconds, all damage dealt to the caster heals [sic] the caster.

30130.name: Bone Spike
30130.description: Bow Attack. A Bone Spike shoots out, dealing 100 damage to target foe. The Bone Spike seems to penetrate all defenses.

30131.name: Flurry of Splinters
30131.description: Bow Attack. A flurry of Bone Splinters shoots out, hitting target foe and up to 5 foes in longbow range for 35 damage per hit over 3 seconds. The Bone Splinters seem to penetrate all defenses.

30133.name: Judgment of Dhuum
30133.description: Spell. For 4 seconds, Dhuum deals 75 damage each second to foes in spirit range.

30134.name: Reaping of Dhuum
30134.description: Scythe Attack. Dhuum deals 200 damage to a new target with each strike. Dhuum only strikes a foe once in this way and will stop this attack after the fourth strike or when no eligible targets are within the area of his last strike. Dhuum is untargetable during this attack.

30135.name: Summon Champion
30135.description: Spell. Summon a Champion of Dhuum.

30137.name: Touch of Dhuum
30137.description: Skill. Steal 100 Health from target touched foe. That foe receives 15% Death Penalty. If Touch of Dhuum steals health from a foe with 60% Death Penalty, that foe dies.

30138.name: Weight of Dhuum
30138.description: Scythe Attack. For 5 seconds, target foe moves and attacks 90% slower, has tripled casting times, benefits 75% less from healing, and has -10 Health degeneration.

30141.name: Aspect of Depletion
30141.description: The Aspect of Depletion is one of two possible environment effects in the Deep.

30151.name: Nightmare Refuge
30151.description: Enchantment Spell. For 10 seconds, 50% of target attacks are blocked, and spells targeting this creature fail 50% of the time. If Nightmare Refuge remains active for its entire duration, it heals Kanaxai for 1,000 Health.

30152.name: Diamondshard Mist
30152.description: Spell. The Remnant of Antiquities begins freezing the condensation within the air, focusing it into crystal shards.

30153.name: Suicide Health
30153.description: Attack. The next time you land a physical attack, you sacrifice all of your Health and target foe loses all Health.

30154.name: Suicide Energy
30154.description: Attack. The next time you land a physical attack, you sacrifice all of your Health and target foe loses all Energy.

30155.name: Forest's Binding
30155.description: Skill. Fires an impaling spike at target foe which causes target to be hexed with "Binding Chains" if it hits.

30156.name: Spectral Agony (On-Hit)
30156.description: Passive. Physical attacks inflict Spectral Agony for 5 seconds, causing affected foes to move, attack, and use skills up to 80% slower, and suffer severe health degeneration.

30157.name: Dhuum
30157.description: Skill. Cannot be hexed or suffer from conditions. Takes 90% less damage.

30158.name: Summon Champion
30158.description: Spell. Summons a Champion of Dhuum to aid in battle.

30159.name: Summon Minions
30159.description: Spell. Summons Minions of Dhuum to aid in battle.

30160.name: Carrier Defense
30160.description: Skill. Teleports nearby foes away from this Siege Turtle.

30161.name: Siege Turtle Attack
30161.description: Skill. Deals 80 blast damage and 250 damage to target.

30162.name: Aura of the Juggernaut
30162.description: Skill. Nearby allies gain +1 Energy regeneration.

30163.name: Juggernaut Toss
30163.description: Touch Skill. Deals 50 damage to target foe and knocks them down for 5 seconds.

30164.name: Mirror Echo
30164.description: Stance. Creates illusory images of the caster.

30165.name: Mirror of Darkness
30165.description: Spell. Create an illusory copy of target foe to fight on your behalf.

30166.name: Smash of the Titans
30166.description: Touch Skill. Target foe loses all Enchantments. All Adjacent Foes are Knocked Down and struck for 150 damage.
